 Tour Dates 2026–2027: All Legs, Cities & Tickets
 October 29, 2026 
 Key Takeaways
 Sylvan Esso’s 2026–2027 tour supports their fifth studio album Ow ∞ , released September 11, 2026, on their Psychic Hotline label.
 The routing includes a fall 2026 North American leg, a January–February 2027 EU/UK run, a February–March 2027 West Coast and Southern U.S. leg, and a Big Ears Festival appearance in April 2027.
 Multiple markets host two-night stands, including Asheville, Washington DC, Minneapolis, Portland OR, and Denver, reflecting strong demand.
 Venues are consistently mid-capacity theaters and clubs, which gives audiences an intimate full-band experience before the duo potentially moves to larger rooms.
 OnesToWatch Live aggregates every confirmed Sylvan Esso date with direct ticket links, resolving gaps and contradictions found on other tour aggregators.

 Leg 1 — Fall 2026 North America (October 2026)
 The fall 2026 North American leg ran from October 1 through October 23, 2026, and now sits in the books as a completed run. The dates below are past as of October 27, 2026, and remain useful for context, routing analysis, and archival reference.
 Past dates from Leg 1:

 October 2, 2026 — The Orange Peel, Asheville, NC — Night one of a two-night hometown-adjacent run.
 October 3, 2026 — The Orange Peel, Asheville, NC — Night two.

 Leg 2 — Winter–Spring 2027 North America (February–March 2027)
 The second North American leg opens February 19, 2027, in Seattle and runs through March 13 in Nashville. The routing traces the West Coast, then turns inland through the Southwest, Mountain West, and South.
 Portland and Denver each host two-night stands, which highlights markets where demand outgrew a single show. The Oakland date is billed as “An Evening with Sylvan Esso,” signaling a longer set format in a historic theater. The Dallas show is presented by KXT, tying the tour into local public radio support.
 Salt Lake City at Rockwell at the Complex on March 4 appears in multiple sources but does not yet have a custom-data ticket link. For that date, and for any other unlinked appearance, check the Live Nation listing or the venue site directly.
 Additional Confirmed Dates And Other Legs
 The broader 2026–2027 routing includes a mix of residencies, festivals, and international headline shows that frame the two main North American legs.
 Earlier in 2026, Sylvan Esso played a sold-out weeklong residency at Sid the Cat Auditorium in Los Angeles from June 15–20, 2026, where the duo workshopped new material with its largest touring configuration to date. Festival appearances included the Winnipeg Folk Festival on July 11, Burlington Waterfront Park in Burlington, Vermont, on July 31, and Blossoms & Bones in Abiquiú, New Mexico, on September 12. UK in-store performances took place at Resident Music in Brighton on September 20 and Rough Trade in London on September 21.
 In late 2026, Sylvan Esso is scheduled to appear at Festival de Frue in Kakegawa, Japan, on October 31–November 1, 2026. A December 5, 2026 DJ set at Raised by Sound Fest in Memphis also appears in reporting and rounds out the year’s festival and special-event footprint.
 The EU/UK leg runs January 26–February 3, 2027 , with six dates: January 26 at National Stadium in Dublin, January 28 at Albert Hall in Manchester, January 29 at Troxy in London, January 31 at Le Cabaret Sauvage in Paris, February 1 at Paradiso in Amsterdam, and February 3 at Astra Kulturhaus in Berlin. Tickets for these dates went on sale October 16, 2026.
 Sylvan Esso is also booked for Big Ears Festival 2027 , running April 1–4, 2027, in downtown Knoxville, Tennessee. The festival booking is confirmed, and passes went on public sale September 16, 2026. The festival’s official artist page lists the duo’s specific date, time, and venue details as still to be determined.
 A Salt Lake City date at Rockwell at the Complex on March 4, 2027 appears across several sources without a direct ticket link. Fans should verify availability with the venue or via Live Nation.
 Patterns, Themes, And Routing Takeaways
 The routing spans two full years and multiple legs: a fall 2026 North American run, late-2026 international dates, a winter 2027 European leg, a spring 2027 West Coast and Southern U.S. leg, and a Big Ears appearance in April 2027. That structure places the Ow ∞ campaign in front of audiences across North America, Europe, the UK, and Japan.
 Multi-night stands in Asheville, Washington DC, Minneapolis, Portland OR, and Denver signal demand that exceeded single-show capacity in each room. Those repeats also underline the tour’s focus on mid-size theaters where a second night is more practical than a jump to arena scale.
 Venues are consistently mid-capacity theaters and clubs such as Brooklyn Paramount, The Wiltern, and Ogden Theatre. The window to see this production in those rooms is limited, especially with a full band and expanded arrangements drawn from the Ow ∞ sessions.
 Good Moon Festival in Durham is a Sylvan Esso–curated event through their Psychic Hotline label, which makes the Durham DPAC dates a distinct experience from the standard headline run. The tour is described as the duo’s largest live iteration to date, with a full band including collaborators from the Ow ∞ sessions.
 OnesToWatch Live’s custom data resolves two recurring discrepancies. Some aggregators list only October 5 for Washington DC and omit the October 6 date, while others fold the October 10 Durham show into a broader October 8–10 Good Moon block. Both dates appear here with confirmed venues and direct ticket links.
 Practical Reader Guidance
 Tickets for the full-band 2026–2027 North American tour went on general sale June 12, 2026, at 10 a.m. local time. Presales began June 11. EU/UK tickets went on sale October 16, 2026.
 For any date without a custom-data link above, check Live Nation or the official Sylvan Esso website for current on-sale status and any updates. No cancellations have been reported as of October 27, 2026.
 For Big Ears 2027, passes are available through the Big Ears Festival site . The festival’s official artist page lists Sylvan Esso’s specific date, time, and venue details as still to be determined, so check back there as the festival approaches.

 Frequently Asked Questions
 Where Is Sylvan Esso Playing In 2026? 
 Sylvan Esso’s 2026 North American headline dates run through October, hitting Atlanta, Asheville, Washington DC, Durham (Good Moon Festival), Philadelphia, Brooklyn, Portland ME, Boston, Toronto, Milwaukee, Chicago, and Minneapolis. Earlier in 2026 the duo played a Los Angeles residency, the Winnipeg Folk Festival, Burlington VT, and Blossoms & Bones in New Mexico, plus UK in-stores in Brighton and London in September. The Japan appearance at Festival de Frue in Kakegawa follows at the end of October.
 Where Is Sylvan Esso Playing In 2027? 
 The 2027 schedule includes a six-date EU/UK leg in January–February covering Dublin, Manchester, London, Paris, Amsterdam, and Berlin. A North American West Coast and Southern leg runs from February 19 through March 13 with shows in Seattle, Vancouver, Portland OR, Oakland, Los Angeles, Santa Ana, Del Mar, Phoenix, Denver, Austin, Dallas, New Orleans, Birmingham, and Nashville, plus a Salt Lake City date noted in multiple sources. Sylvan Esso is also booked for Big Ears Festival in Knoxville, Tennessee, April 1–4, 2027, with specific set details still to be announced.
 What Album Is Sylvan Esso Touring In Support Of? 
 The 2026–2027 tour supports Ow ∞ , Sylvan Esso’s fifth studio album, released September 11, 2026, via their own Psychic Hotline label. The imprint was founded by Amelia Meath, Nick Sanborn, and their longtime manager Martin Anderson, and officially launched on August 4, 2021 . The record was produced by the duo at their Betty’s studio in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, and features a large ensemble of collaborators including Glenn Kotche, Jenn Wasner, and TJ Maiani.
 Is Sylvan Esso Playing Multiple Nights In Any Cities? 
 Yes. The routing includes two-night stands in Asheville NC (October 2–3 at The Orange Peel), Washington DC (October 5–6 at 9:30 Club), Minneapolis (October 23 at First Avenue, with a second night noted in some listings), Portland OR (February 22–23 at McMenamins Crystal Ballroom), and Denver (March 5–6 at Ogden Theatre). The Good Moon Festival in Durham spans October 8–10, with Sylvan Esso headlining two of the three nights at DPAC.
 What Is Good Moon Festival And How Does It Relate To Sylvan Esso? 
 Good Moon Festival is a biennial festival curated by Sylvan Esso and their Psychic Hotline label, held in their hometown of Durham, North Carolina; it debuted in 2022 at the Historic Durham Athletic Park, moved to Durham Bulls Athletic Park in 2024, and returned October 8–10, 2026 . The 2026 edition takes over four venues across Durham, anchored by three nights at the Durham Performing Arts Center. Sylvan Esso headlines two of those nights, while Tyler Childers headlines the third. The broader lineup includes Meshell Ndegeocello, MJ Lenderman, aja monet, Jacques Greene, Circuit des Yeux, and others, and functions as a distinct ticketed event from the standard headline tour.
 Conclusion
 OnesToWatch Live serves as a central tour hub for Sylvan Esso’s 2026–2027 activity because its first-party ticketing data gathers every confirmed venue and live ticket link in one place. The full routing appears here in chronological order, from the fall 2026 North American leg through the EU/UK dates, the West Coast and Southern 2027 leg, and Big Ears.
 These shows take place in mid-capacity theaters and clubs with a full band behind one of 2026’s key independent releases. Audiences who prefer that scale of room should move early, since demand in several markets already supports multi-night stands.
